title: Dependabot Analyzer Configuration
description: Per-project configuration for the dependabot-analyzer plugin. Place at .claude/dependabot-analyzer.json in your project root.

auto_merge.description: Controls automatic merging of low-risk Dependabot PRs.

enabled.description: Whether to auto-merge PRs that fall within the safe threshold.

max_semver.description: Maximum semver bump level eligible for auto-merge.

require_ci_pass.description: Require all CI checks to pass before auto-merging.

exclude_packages.description: Package names that should never be auto-merged, regardless of risk score.

issue_tracker.description: Where to create issues for PRs requiring deeper review.

linear_config.description: Required when issue_tracker is 'linear'. Linear project configuration.

label_ids.description: Linear label IDs to apply to created issues.

labels.description: Labels to apply to created GitHub issues.

batch_size.description: Maximum number of parallel analysis agents to launch at once.

repos.description: Repositories to analyze. Use '.' for the current repo, or 'owner/repo' slugs for other repos.

risk_thresholds.description: Risk score thresholds that control when issues are created and merges are blocked.

create_issue_above.description: Create an issue for PRs with a risk score above this value.

block_merge_above.description: Never auto-merge PRs with a risk score above this value.
